item.title: Japan's Nidec CEO Mitsuya Kishida to resign, Nikkei reports
item.description: Japanese motor maker Nidec's president Mitsuya Kishida has decided to step down as CEO, the Nikkei business daily reported on Tuesday, based on information it obtained a day earlier.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Japanese motor maker Nidec's (6594.T) president Mitsuya Kishida has decided to step down as CEO, the Nikkei business daily reported on Tuesday, based on information it obtained a day earlier. Kishida may submit his resignation as early as Tuesday, the report added. Here are some more details: Michio Kaida, the company's chief technology officer, is among the potential successors, but the company is also weighing an appointment from its current directors, the report said. Nidec did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. The board, largely made up of outside directors, intends to replace Kishida to clarify accountability for the problems facing the company, the report said. Nikkei had reported on Monday that Nidec is expected to recognize an impairment loss exceeding 600 billion yen ($3.81 billion) stemming mainly from traction motor systems for electric vehicles. The write-downs, including revisions tied to the accounting scandal revealed in June 2025, could total about 1 trillion yen, Nikkei had said. The company [USN:L6N3ZR0YJ TEXT:"had anticipated"] an impairment loss of 250 billion yen in March. Nidec plans on Wednesday to file its securities report for the year ended March and announce corrections to financial results for the past five years. ($1 = 157.3800 yen)

item.title: Report: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) week-to-week
item.description: New York Jets starting running back Breece Hall is week-to-week with a quad injury after undergoing an MRI Monday, ESPN and NFL Network reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New York Jets starting running back Breece Hall is week-to-week with a quad injury after undergoing an MRI Monday, ESPN and NFL Network reported. According to reports, the MRI was received as good news because the injury was not as significant as initially feared. Hall, 25, was hurt on the opening drive of the fourth quarter in Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Lions in Detroit. The Jets (1-2) quickly ruled him out for the rest of the game, and Braelon Allen replaced him in the backfield. Hall was dragged down on a second-and-goal carry at the Detroit 4 and immediately grabbed his outer right thigh near his hip. Hall took a misdirection toss to the right and raced to get the edge, but he was met by linebacker Trevor Nowaske for no gain. Hall had 13 carries for 32 yards and caught three passes for 23 yards. In three games this season, Hall has rushed for 163 yards on 51 carries and one touchdown and caught 10 passes for 102 yards. In his fifth season with the Jets since they selected him in the second round of the 2022 NFL Draft, he has 3,561 rushing yards on 806 carries and 19 scores in 59 games (53 starts). He also has 198 receptions for 1,744 yards and nine touchdowns. --Field Level Media

item.title: ネタニヤフ氏がＵＡＥ訪問、二国間関係巡り協議＝国営通信
item.description: [カイロ ２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[カイロ　２８日　ロイター] - イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相が２７日にアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）を訪問し、ムハンマド大統領と会談した。ＵＡＥの国営通信ＷＡＭが２８日、報じた。

ＷＡＭは、両首脳がＵＡＥとイスラエルの二国間関係について協議したと伝えた。ＷＡＭの報道は、ネタニヤフ氏の訪問をＵＡＥが初めて公式に確認するものとなる。

イスラエル首相府は２８日、ネタニヤフ氏はムハンマド大統領の招待で訪問したと発表。訪問は「両国間の関係強化と地域の課題に焦点を当てたものだった」と説明した。

イスラエル政府高官３人によると、２７日の会談は６時間に及び、イランに関する議論が中心だった。

イスラエル首相府は５月、ネタニヤフ氏がＵＡＥを「秘密裏に訪問」し、ムハンマド大統領と会談したと発表したが、ＵＡＥ側は両者の会談を否定していた。会談に詳しい関係者は当時、ネタニヤフ氏とムハンマド大統領が３月２６日、オマーンとの国境沿いにあるアブダビのオアシス都市アルアインで会談したと明らかにしていた。

ＵＡＥは今回の中東紛争で攻撃にさらされて以来、米国やイスラエルとの関係を強化してきた。イスラエルとは２０２０年のアブラハム合意により国交を正常化している。ＵＡＥにとって、イスラエルとの関係は域内での影響力を発揮する手段となるとともに、米政府への独自のパイプにもなっている。

item.title: NASA chief says Boeing Starliner parts to be redesigned for 2028 flight
item.description: NASA chief Jared Isaacman said on Monday that parts of Boeing's Starliner spacecraft will be redesigned ahead of a crewed flight in 2028, and he added in a briefing that Starliner will fly up to five crewed missions to the International Space Station for NASA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: NASA chief Jared Isaacman said on Monday that parts of Boeing's (BA.N) Starliner spacecraft will be redesigned ahead of a crewed flight in 2028, and he added in a briefing that Starliner will fly up to five crewed missions to the International Space Station for NASA. Boeing has implemented fixes on Starliner-1 after identifying the cause of the spacecraft's helium leaks, said Dana Weigel, NASA program manager for the space station.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（28日） 4:44 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

まちまちで取引を終えた。鉱業株に売り注文が目立ち、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に反落した。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．３１％高。

米国が戦闘終結に絡むイランの提案を拒否したことを受け、原油価格が上昇。インフレ懸念から市場は利上げ観測を強めた。

金や銅の値下がりを受け、ＦＴＳＥ３５０種貴金属株指数は４．９４％、鉱業株指数は１．２４％それぞれ下落した。金生産のエンデバー・マイニングは４．４％、フレスニヨは５．１％、資源大手グレンコアは１．７％、アングロ・アメリカンは１．９％いずれも値下がりした。

住宅建設株指数は１０．０１％高。英政府が、住宅販売を促進するため、来月発表の予算案に融資の枠組みを盛り込む計画を明らかにしたことが好感された。住宅建設大手バラット・レッドロウ、パーシモン、テイラー・ウィンペイ、べルウェイは１０．３─１４．７％上昇した。

イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のラムズデン副総裁は、インフレの高止まりが金利判断に影響しかねないと示唆した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 　横ばい圏で推移し、小幅に続伸して取引を終えた。英住宅建設株が買われ、相場全体を支えた。資源株は売り注文が優勢だった。地域別では、スペインのＩＢＥＸ指数が０．５１％安と下げが目立った。    トランプ米大統領は、ホルムズ海峡の再開と戦闘終結に向けたイランの提案を拒否。ブレント原油先物価格は上昇し、インフレ懸念が強まった。ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りが一時３．６４３％を付けるなど、長期金利は高止まりしている。    英住宅建設のパーシモン、バラット・レッドロウ、テイラー・ウィンペイ、ビストリー・グループは１０．７％─１４．７％上昇した。英政府による住宅政策が好材料視された。    ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種石油・ガス株指数は０．８０％高。    一方、金や銅が値下がりし、資源株指数は１．１４％安。金生産のエンデバー・マイニングは４．４％、フレスニヨは５．１％、ホックシールド・マイニングは７．２％いずれも下落した。    工業株指数は０．３８％、テクノロジー株指数は０．２４％それぞれ下落した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　域内国債利回りが上昇した。米国とイランの紛争が早期に解決するとの期待が後退したことで原油価格が上昇した。 市場では、週内に相次いで予定される主要経済指標の発表にも注目が集まる。    トランプ米大統領は２６日、ホルムズ海峡の再開と中東での戦闘終結を目指すイランの提案を拒否したと明らかにした。これを受け、北海ブレント先物は約４％上昇し、１バレル＝１０８．５０ドルとなった。    エネルギー価格の上昇と利上げ観測を背景に、世界的に国債への圧力が続いている。欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）は今年に入り既に２回利上げを実施しており、金融市場は年末までに少なくともあと１回の利上げが実施されるとの見方を織り込んでいる。    こうした中、市場の注目は週内に予定される域内の消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）速報値の発表に移っている。 ロイターの調査によると、９月のユーロ圏のインフレ率は３．６％と、８月の３．２％から伸びが加速すると予想されている。    ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは２ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の３．６４％と、２００９年６月以来の高水準付近となった。同利回りは先週まで７週連続で週間ベースの上昇を記録し、月間では３１ｂｐを超える上昇となる見通し。    ドイツ２年債利回りは１．５ｂｐ上昇の３．３０％。先週まで週間ベースで７週連続上昇していた。    イタリア２年債利回りは約６ｂｐ上昇の３．５８％。

item.title: トランプ氏、米は「間もなく」イラン紛争で勝利へ 仲介者と協議
item.description:
Bo Erickson Trevor Hunnicutt
[ワシントン ２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Trevor Hunnicutt

[ワシントン ２８日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は、米当局者が２８日にイランとの紛争終結に向けて仲介者らと協議したと明らかにし、米国は「間もなく」イランとの戦争に勝利するとの認識を示した。

トランプ大統領は記者団に対し「われわれはいずれ勝利するだろう」とし、「かなり早く決着するだろう」と語った。

また、米国の勝利後にガソリン価格は急落するとの見通しを改めて示した。

item.title: Exportação de petróleo do Brasil caminha para recorde em setembro, indicam dados da Secex
item.description: A exportação de petróleo do Brasil somou até a quarta semana de setembro 10,1 milhões de toneladas, caminhando para bater um recorde histórico mensal que durava mais de três anos, de acordo com dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex), divulgados nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Roberto Samora
item.content:encoded: A exportação de petróleo do Brasil somou até a quarta semana de setembro 10,1 milhões de toneladas, caminhando para bater um recorde histórico mensal que durava mais de três anos, de acordo com dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex), divulgados nesta segunda-feira. Com mais três dias úteis para serem contabilizados até o final do mês e uma média de exportação de mais de 500 mil toneladas por dia no acumulado de setembro, o Brasil poderia superar o volume histórico de 11 milhões de toneladas, marcado em março de 2023, segundo informações de embarques da Secex. As exportações por dia útil subiram 50% em relação a setembro completo de 2025, segundo dados da secretaria, com o país sendo beneficiado pela produção recorde de petróleo nos últimos meses. O especialista de Inteligência de Mercado da StoneX Bruno Cordeiro afirmou que o impulso das exportações pode estar sendo influenciado pelo aumento da produção de petróleo do Brasil, que deve bater novo recorde em setembro, e pela parada de manutenção programada da refinaria da Petrobras (PETR3.SA) no Paraná Repar. "O Brasil vem registrando recorde atrás de recorde nesses últimos meses na extração de petróleo. Então, essa tendência se mantém aqui para o mês de setembro, olhando para dados prévios (da ANP)", disse Cordeiro. Além disso, os problemas relacionados à guerra no Irã, que afetam o fluxo de combustíveis pelo Estreito de Ormuz, também trouxeram este ano alguma [USN:L1N40R0W8 TEXT:"demanda adicional"] ao Brasil, inclusive da China. Em julho, segundo dados da agência reguladora ANP, a produção mensal de petróleo do Brasil bateu recorde [USN:L6N44T0SF TEXT:"pelo segundo mês consecutivo"], sustentada pelos campos do pré-sal, especialmente Búzios e Mero, na Bacia de Santos. Os dados de agosto deverão ser divulgados no início de outubro. Com a guerra no Irã, os preços de petróleo mais altos no mercado internacional impulsionam ainda mais as receitas com as exportações da commodity, que tinham superado US$5,6 bilhões no acumulado até a quarta semana de setembro. A tonelada de petróleo, segundo a Secex, foi exportada no acumulado de setembro a uma média de US$562,4, alta anual de 26,1%.

item.title: トランプ氏、中西部アイオワ州の製鉄所建設発表 中間選挙控えアピール
item.description: ［２８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２８日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は２８日、中西部アイオワ州に１５０億ドル規模の製鉄所が建設されると明らかにした。１１月の中間選挙を前に、共和党政権が製造業復活の成果としてアピールする材料になりそうだ。

トランプ氏によると、製鉄所を建設するのは中西部ミネソタ州に拠点を置くメサビ・メタリックス。同社はミネソタ州で５０年ぶりとなる鉄鉱石鉱山をこのほど開設した。

トランプ氏はホワイトハウスで同社の幹部らと共に計画を発表。記者団に対し「極めて大規模な投資になる」とし、「米鉄鋼業は力強く復活しつつある」と語った。

１１月の中間選挙を控え、共和党がインフレや生活費を巡る有権者の不満に直面する中、トランプ氏は自身の経済政策の成果をアピールしようとしている。同氏は関税と米製造業の復活を経済政策の中核に据え、輸入障壁の引き上げが投資と雇用を米国に呼び戻すと主張してきた。

アイオワ州はかつて激戦州だったが、近年は共和党への投票傾向が強まっている。ただ今回は、複数の選挙で共和党が接戦を強いられている。

新事業は、メサビがミネソタ州の自社鉱山で採掘した鉄鉱石を使ってアイオワ州で鉄鋼を生産する、完全な垂直統合型となる。第１段階の年間生産量は７５０万トンで、最終的には１０００万トンに達する見込み。ホワイトハウスは米国史上最大の製鉄所になるとしている。

製鉄事業で使用する鉄鉱石は、アイオワ州境から約４００キロ離れたミネソタ州ナッシュウォークにある同社の鉱山で採掘される。メサビを所有するインドの複合企業エッサール・グループは同鉱山に２５億ドル超を投資している。

ホワイトハウスによると、アイオワ州の製鉄所は少なくとも１７５０人の恒常的な雇用を生み出す見込み。第１段階では最大６０００人の建設雇用も支える見通しだ。建設期間と稼働開始後１０年間で総額９５０億ドルの経済効果を生む見込みで、鉄鋼生産の開始は２０３０年を予定しているという。

item.title: 今冬のガス価格上昇を警戒、インフレ主因はエネルギー＝ポルトガル中銀総裁
item.description: [リスボン １５日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのペレイラ・ポルトガル中銀総裁は２８日、イ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
今冬のガス価格上昇を警戒、インフレ主因はエネルギー＝ポルトガル中銀総裁 4:10 配信

スペイン・マドリードのガソリンスタンドで2022年4月撮影。REUTERS/Susana Vera

[リスボン　１５日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのペレイラ・ポルトガル中銀総裁は２８日、インフレの主な要因はエネルギー製品であり、天然ガス価格の上昇が今冬の物価見通しにとって主要なリスクの一つになるとの認識を示した。

ペレイラ氏はリスボンで開催されたイベントで、精製燃料価格が原油や天然ガスの価格よりもはるかに大きく上昇しており、これがインフレ圧力をさらに強めていると指摘。「今冬、われわれが直面する主なリスクの一つは、天然ガス価格への一段の上昇圧力だ。これによりインフレ圧力が高まるだろう」と述べた。

item.title: Trump says US will win Iran war 'very soon'
item.description: US President Donald Trump told reporters that United States officials talked with mediators trying to end Washington's war with Iran on Monday, adding the US will win the Iran war "very soon."
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Trevor Hunnicutt
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump told reporters that United States officials talked with mediators trying to end Washington's war with Iran on Monday, adding the US will win the Iran war "very soon." "We're going to win, as far as I'm concerned, it's going to be one way or the other," Trump said in the Oval Office. "It's going to go pretty quickly." Trump also said that gas prices will come tumbling down after the US wins the war.

item.title: トランプ氏とＡＩ業界幹部の会合、ザッカーバーグ氏やアモデイ氏ら出席へ
item.description:
Katharine Jackson
[ワシントン ２８日] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Katharine Jackson

[ワシントン　２８日] - ジョンソン米下院議長は２８日、トランプ大統領がテクノロジー企業の最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）らと２９日にホワイトハウスで開く人工知能（ＡＩ）を巡る会合について、革新と監督体制のバランスを見い出すことに焦点が置かれると述べた。

事情に詳しい関係筋によると、２９日の会合には、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）を運営する米メタ・プラットフォームズのマーク・ザッカーバーグ氏、人工知能（ＡＩ）新興企業アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）、オープンＡＩの共同創業者で社長のグレッグ・ブロックマン氏、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンＣＥＯが出席する。このほか、アルファベット傘下グーグルのスンダー・ピチャイＣＥＯ、スペースＸＡＩ幹部のイーロン・マスク氏が出席する可能性がある。

ジョンソン氏はフォックス・ビジネス・ネットワークとの２８日のインタビューで「モラトリアム（一時停止）は必要ない。過剰な規制に踏み込む必要もない。そうすれば中国との競争に負けてしまうからだ」と言及。「イノベーションを継続することは重要だが、適切なバランスを見出す必要がある。今回の会合ではそれが主眼となる」と語った。

主要ＡＩ企業は、ますます高性能化するＡＩシステムの開発ペース減速を訴え、この強力な技術を管理するために各国政府が協力するよう求めている。

一方、トランプ氏は中国に対する米国の競争力優位の維持を重視し、ＡＩの悪用が人々に害を及ぼすとの懸念を意に介さない姿勢を示している。

ジョンソン氏は、米国は安全性に留意すべきだが、技術開発を阻害してはならないと指摘。「問題が生じれば司法省が役割を果たす余地はあると思う。だが、その段階に至る前に必要なのは透明性であり、一定の監督体制だ」と述べた。

こうした中、下院民主党トップのジェフリーズ院内総務はＣＮＢＣのインタビューで、ＡＩ業界の幹部らが政府による何らかの対応を求めていると述べ、議会には米国民を守る責任があると指摘。

「ＡＩの安全性については、われわれは今こそ、果敢かつ責任をもって積極的に取り組む必要がある」と語った。

ＡＩ技術を巡っては安全性や雇用喪失、一握りのテクノロジー企業への権力集中への懸念が高まる中、超党派の議員からトランプ氏の不干渉的な姿勢に疑問の声が上がっている。

トランプ氏は２７日、アンソロピックのアモデイＣＥＯと夕食を共にした。

item.title: Colombia en conversaciones con funcionarios del FMI sobre eventual acuerdo: fuentes
item.description: El Gobierno de Colombia ha sostenido conversaciones técnicas avanzadas con funcionarios del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) desde hace varias semanas, en busca de llegar a un eventual acuerdo que permita poner en orden las finanzas del país sudamericano, dijeron el lunes a Reuters tres fuentes con conocimiento del asunto.
item.dc:creator: Nelson Bocanegra, Andrea Shalal, Carlos Vargas
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno de Colombia ha sostenido conversaciones técnicas avanzadas con funcionarios del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) desde hace varias semanas, en busca de llegar a un eventual acuerdo que permita poner en orden las finanzas del país sudamericano, dijeron el lunes a Reuters tres fuentes con conocimiento del asunto. El presidente de Colombia, Abelardo De La Espriella, anunció el domingo por la noche que dio instrucciones al equipo económico para que sostenga conversaciones con el FMI a fin de buscar una salida a la crisis fiscal que enfrenta el país. Las fuentes, que pidieron mantener sus nombres en reserva, aseguraron que las conversaciones han girado en torno a lograr un financiamiento alternativo con mejores tasas de interés, en momentos en que el país ha incrementado sus metas de endeudamiento interno y externo debido al amplio déficit fiscal esperado para este y el próximo año. Otra fuente cercana a las conversaciones dijo a Reuters que personal del FMI se encuentra actualmente en Colombia para una visita institucional programada, encabezada por el subdirector gerente, Nigel Clarke. El Ministerio de Hacienda no respondió inmediatamente a una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters. La fuente señaló que es demasiado pronto para abordar detalles sobre la magnitud de un posible programa de financiación del FMI. Avanzar hacia un programa requeriría una visita específica del personal técnico y conversaciones con las autoridades colombianas, explicó la fuente. El vicepresidente colombiano, José Manuel Restrepo, y el equipo económico del país comentaron en algunos encuentros con empresarios e inversionistas de los mercados de capitales en Nueva York los acercamientos que han tenido con el FMI y la intención de buscar un acuerdo, dijeron dos de las fuentes. El Gobierno elevó la meta de déficit fiscal para este año a 7,2% del Producto Interno Bruto (PIB) desde una previa de 5,3% y para 2027 la disparó hasta un récord de 9,4% del PIB frente al 4,5% previsto anteriormente. El Gobierno aumentará su endeudamiento en más de 10.500 millones de dólares adicionales este año y para 2027 más que se duplicará a 71.660 millones de dólares, desde los 32.976 millones de dólares previstos antes. Colombia atraviesa dificultades fiscales en medio de un menor recaudo tributario, un gasto ampliado durante el anterior gobierno de izquierda y una inflación persistente. De La Espriella ha prometido medidas de austeridad de gran alcance para recortar el gasto, pero tendrán que ser aprobadas por el Congreso. "Buscar el acompañamiento del FMI es una opción responsable para enfrentar la situación fiscal. Puede aportar respaldo técnico, abrir opciones de financiamiento y fortalecer la confianza. El desafío es avanzar con disciplina fiscal, austeridad y eficiencia del gasto, mientras se generan condiciones para recuperar la inversión y crear empleo", dijo la Cámara de Comercio Colombo Americana. En septiembre de 2025, el Banco Central de Colombia canceló el acuerdo de línea de crédito flexible con el FMI que el país tenía vigente desde abril de 2024 por un período de dos años y por un monto de 6.133,5 millones de Derechos Especiales de Giro (DEG), lo que equivalía en la fecha de la aprobación del acuerdo a un monto cercano a los 8.100 millones de dólares. El Gobierno anunció que desde el 16 de noviembre realizará la "Milagro Week" en Nueva York, una iniciativa en la que presentará a inversionistas un portafolio de 176 proyectos, de los cuales 37 son prioritarios, en sectores de infraestructura, energía, minerales críticos, turismo y tecnología.

item.title: Pennsylvania measles cases cross 900 as outbreak grows
item.description: Pennsylvania's measles outbreak continued to worsen, with 68 new infections reported since Wednesday last week, bringing the total to 903 on Monday, health department data showed, as the state grapples with the worst measles resurgence in decades.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pennsylvania's measles outbreak continued to worsen, with 68 new infections reported since Wednesday last week, bringing the total to 903 on Monday, health department data showed, as the state grapples with the worst measles resurgence in decades. Here are more details: According to the Pennsylvania Department of Health, 176 measles patients had been hospitalized, up from 164 reported on September 23 Lancaster County, with the highest number of cases, remains the hardest-hit area in the state Pennsylvania reported [USN:L4N4571A0 TEXT:"four measles-related deaths"] among unvaccinated residents earlier this month, sparking a disagreement between Governor Josh Shapiro and US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. over how many of the fatalities were directly caused by the virus Soon after, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said it was [USN:L4N45A17G TEXT:"reviewing"] how it classifies measles-related deaths The CDC's website now lists one [USN:L4N45F199 TEXT:"verified measles death"] but did not confirm where the death had occurred The US has recorded 3,659 measles cases this year as of September 24, according to CDC data Measles is a highly contagious viral disease that can cause fever, rash and respiratory complications, but can be easily prevented with the measles, mumps and rubella vaccine — a routine childhood immunization that provides 97% protection after two doses

item.title: 英10年債利回り、2007年7月来の高水準 米債の動向に追随
item.description: [ロンドン ２８日 ロイター] - 英国の１０年物国債利回りが２８日、２００７年７月以来の高水準に上昇した。トランプ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英10年債利回り、2007年7月来の高水準　米債の動向に追随 3:26 配信

[ロンドン ２８日 ロイター] - 英国の１０年物国債利回りが２８日、２００７年７月以来の高水準に上昇した。トランプ米大統領がホルムズ海峡の再開通に関するイランの提案を拒否したことで原油価格が上昇し、米国債利回りが上昇したことに追随した。

１０年物英国債利回りは１５００ＧＭＴ（日本時間２９日午前０時）時点で７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）超上昇し、５．４４１％となった。

１０年物米国債利回りは前日比８ｂｐ上昇の５．２６％、原油価格は３％高の１バレル＝１０８ドル近辺となった。

今回の動きは国際的な要因に起因するものだが、来月に初の予算演説を控えるヒーリー英財務相にとっては歓迎できない材料だ。

金利見通しに敏感な２年物英国債利回りは、約１０ｂｐ上昇し４．９４％を付けた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：バーナム英首相の新しいＳＮＳ戦略、包摂型発信で右派と差別化 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず コラム：ＥＵにメリット多い英の再加盟、将来申請なら歓迎が得策 アングル：英国債、有力機関投資家は強気維持　「トラス・ショック」記憶が歯止めと期待 コラム：英国債利回り抑制、政治問題で片付けず「経済的」対応不可欠 最終更新: 9/29(火) 3:26 ロイター

item.title: Colombia has held discussions with IMF, including on securing financing: sources
item.description: The Colombian government has held a series of technical advance discussions with officials from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) over the past several weeks, particularly about securing financing, in an effort to reach a potential agreement that could help restore order to the South American country's finances, three sources with knowledge of the matter told Reuters on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Nelson Bocanegra, Carlos Vargas, Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: The Colombian government has held a series of technical advance discussions with officials from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) over the past several weeks, particularly about securing financing, in an effort to reach a potential agreement that could help restore order to the South American country's finances, three sources with knowledge of the matter told Reuters on Monday. Colombian President Abelardo De La Espriella said late on Sunday that he had instructed his economic team to hold talks with the IMF to seek a way out of the fiscal crisis. The sources, who requested anonymity because the discussions are private, said the talks have focused on securing alternative financing at more favorable rates, as the country has increased its domestic and external borrowing targets amid a wide fiscal deficit expected this year and next. Another source familiar with the discussions told Reuters that IMF staff are currently in Colombia on a scheduled institutional visit led by Deputy Managing Director Nigel Clarke. That source said it was too early to discuss any details about the size of a possible IMF financing program and that moving toward a program would require a dedicated staff visit and discussions with Colombian authorities. The finance ministry did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Colombian Vice President Jose Manuel Restrepo and the country's economic team discussed their contacts with the IMF and their intention to seek an agreement during some meetings with business leaders and capital markets investors in New York, two of the sources said. "I have given clear instructions to the finance minister and the entire economic team to take charge of talks with the International Monetary Fund. I have given that instruction in order to seek a negotiated solution to the crisis," De La Espriella said in a televised address on Sunday night. "We all know that the country's fiscal situation is the most critical in our history." The IMF said it had no immediate comment on De La Espriella's Sunday remarks. Colombia is fiscally struggling amid lower tax revenue, expanded spending under the previous leftist government and persistent inflation. De La Espriella has promised sweeping austerity measures to cut spending. The government has raised its fiscal deficit target for this year to 7.2% of gross domestic product (GDP) from a previous 5.3%, and has increased the target to a record 9.4% of GDP for next year. It will increase borrowing by more than $10.5 billion this year. In 2027, borrowing is set reach to $71.66 billion, more than double what was initially planned.

item.title: US FAA delays Boeing 737 MAX 10 certification, shares dive 7%
item.description: The US Federal Aviation Administration said on Monday it will hold off certifying Boeing's long-delayed 737 MAX 10 until a newly-disclosed software issue is resolved, the latest setback to the planemaker's efforts to bring the largest version of its best-selling jet to market.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson, Allison Lampert
item.content:encoded: The US Federal Aviation Administration said on Monday it will hold off certifying Boeing's (BA.N) long-delayed 737 MAX 10 until a newly-disclosed software issue is resolved, the latest setback to the planemaker's efforts to bring the largest version of its best-selling jet to market. Boeing said on Saturday [USN:L1N45I05Q TEXT:"a software issue affecting certain 737 MAX aircraft"] could prevent pilots from accessing automated flight guidance during a specific landing scenario. The company said it had informed operators and was developing a software update to permanently address the problem. Boeing shares closed down 6.9% over concerns about further delays to the MAX 10, a key aircraft in Boeing's effort to regain ground lost to Airbus (AIR.PA) in the lucrative single-aisle market. "We will be delaying the 10 until we're satisfied that we don't have an issue here," FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford told reporters at an event at Reagan Washington National Airport. He declined to estimate the length of the delay. The FAA said the software version can increase pilot workload when doing a go-around, where a pilot aborts a landing attempt, applies power, and climbs back into the sky to try to land again. The FAA said earlier it planned to convene a Corrective Action Review Board to investigate the issue. However, the board is not likely to take place before next week at the earliest, two sources told Reuters. The review by the U.S. regulator will test whether the software poses an unreasonable risk to safety, which could lead to more months of rework before the MAX 10 could get certified, which was widely expected to take place in October. NOT A SAFETY CONCERN However, WestJet, the Canadian carrier backed by Onex Corp (ONEX.TO) and one of the airlines operating the software on its 737 MAX fleet, said it had not experienced any in-service issues and did not view the matter as a safety concern. "We have standard operating procedures and training to mitigate this type of event," the Calgary-based carrier said in a statement. Three WestJet 737 MAX pilots, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said they were not aware of any issues with the software when performing missed approaches, a rare procedure. Bedford said the software was supplied by jet engine maker and supplier GE Aerospace (GE.N) , and suggested a fix could be developed relatively quickly. "I think in this particular case, due to the focus that's on it, GE may try to get this software correction in much quicker," Bedford said. "Is that weeks, days, months? I don't know." Despite the bug, pilots maintained control, unlike undisclosed 737 MAX automatic flight control software that was involved in two crashes in 2018 and 2019, he said. GE Aerospace did not immediately respond to a request for comment. “We continue to follow the lead of the FAA as we work through the certification process," a Boeing spokesperson said. Alaska Airlines (ALK.N) and United Airlines (UAL.O) said none of their aircraft currently use the affected software. United said it is not accepting deliveries of aircraft equipped with the software version under review, while Alaska said it is working with Boeing and the FAA as they evaluate the issue.

item.title: インフレ圧力継続へ、追加利上げは指標次第＝クックＦＲＢ理事
item.description: [オークランド（米カリフォルニア州）２８日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事は２８日、人工知能（Ａ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インフレ圧力継続へ、追加利上げは指標次第＝クックＦＲＢ理事 3:08 配信

2012年4月3日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）。REUTERS/Joshua Roberts/File Photo

[オークランド（米カリフォルニア州）２８日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事は２８日、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の需要と原油高を背景に、今後数カ月はインフレ圧力が続くとの見通しを示した。ただ、追加利上げが必要になるとの明言は避けた。

カリフォルニア州オークランドで開かれるＡＩと新興技術に関する会議向けの講演原稿で「労働市場は利上げに十分対応できる状態にあるようだ」と指摘。「今後、インフレ率を引き続き目標に向けて低下させるため、どの程度の政策金利が必要かを検討する。当然ながら、今後の調整の回数と幅は、これまでの政策措置に対する経済の反応と、今後数カ月のインフレ・雇用統計を踏まえて判断する」と述べた。

ＦＲＢは９月、インフレ率を２％の目標に「より速やかに」戻すため、３年ぶりに政策金利を引き上げた。決定は全会一致で、クック氏も賛成した。

金融市場は現在、ＦＲＢが１０月に利上げする確率を約７５％と織り込み、１２月の会合で３会合連続の利上げに踏み切る可能性も高いと見ている。

クック氏は講演原稿で、こうした市場の見方を追認しなかった。ただ、インフレ率は「高過ぎる状態があまりに長く続いている」とし、８月までの１２カ月間の総合インフレ率が約３．８％と、２％目標のほぼ２倍だったと指摘した。

「さらに今後数カ月は、本日述べたＡＩ関連基盤の拡充に加え、中東紛争に伴う原油高と供給網の混乱の波及により、インフレ圧力が続くと予想する」と述べた。

ＡＩによる生産性向上は中期的に一定のインフレ鈍化をもたらすと見込む一方、２６年中のインフレ圧力を相殺できるほど早く効果が表れることはないと指摘。インフレ指標は、こうした物価上昇圧力がＡＩ関連分野以外にも広がっていることを示していると述べた。

講演では主にＡＩの経済への影響を取り上げた。クック氏はＡＩを、経済を一変させる可能性を持つ汎用技術と位置付けている。

現時点では、ＡＩが労働市場の構造を変えつつあることを示す証拠はほとんど見られないと説明。ただ、少なくとも一時的に失業率を押し上げる可能性を「強く警戒している」と付け加えた。その場合、労働市場を支えるための利下げがインフレを助長しかねず、ＦＲＢの対応余地は限られるとした。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：ＦＲＢが狙う「雇用損なわない」インフレ抑制、コロナ禍後の再現なるか コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：ドル安進んでも円高は小幅、来年のクロス円は円安継続か＝佐々木融氏 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：9月ＦＯＭＣ、ドットプロット更新で金利見通しに波乱も 最終更新: 9/29(火) 3:08 ロイター

Sept 28 : Anthropic on Monday released Claude Sonnet 5.5, the second model in its Claude 5.5 family, as the AI lab expands its product lineup ahead of a planned IPO. Here are some more details: • Sonnet 5.5 is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, unchanged from its predecessor, Sonnet 5. Anthropic said the model needs fewer tokens to complete the same work. • The company said Sonnet 5.5 is a faster, lower-cost complement to Claude Opus 5.5, which it launched last week at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens.

item.title: Dutch 'reformed hacker' arrested in ShinyHunters investigation, police and ex-boss say
item.description: A Dutch man whose journey from cybercriminal to reformed security professional was widely covered in the international media has been arrested as part of an investigation into the hacker group ShinyHunters, Dutch police and the man's boss said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter, Anthony Deutsch, Andrew Goudsward
item.content:encoded: A Dutch man whose journey from cybercriminal to reformed security professional was widely covered in the international media has been arrested as part of an investigation into the hacker group ShinyHunters, Dutch police and the man's boss said on Monday. In a statement posted to social media site X, Dutch police said a 24-year-old man had been arrested in connection with the inquiry and would appear in court in Rotterdam on Tuesday. The statement did not name the man. But Benjamin Korper of Amsterdam-based cybersecurity company Neo Security said it was Pepijn van der Stap, the company's offensive security lead. In a telephone interview with Reuters, Korper said Dutch forensic investigators visited his office on September 15, the night Van der Stap was arrested in a dramatic police raid that involved flash bang grenades . The arrest comes amid escalating concern over ShinyHunters, a hacking group known for large-scale data breaches and extortion, and its recent theft of what it said was terabytes of sensitive personnel data from US FBI servers. At least some of the data includes employees' [USN:L6N45F0ZI TEXT:"intelligence assignments"] and [USN:L6N45H0U5 TEXT:"medical records"], Reuters has reported. Some compared this to the [USN:L1N0YR16W TEXT:"disastrous 2015 hack"] of the US Office of Personnel Management. An internal memo said the FBI was operating under the presumption that hackers stole data pertaining to all bureau employees, according to a person briefed on the matter. The memo's existence was earlier reported by MS Now. In a statement, ShinyHunters said Van der Stap had "no association" with the group and that Dutch police were incompetent. The hackers said that now they were not setting a deadline for the FBI to rescind an advisory about ShinyHunters , softening their initial statement which gave the FBI a week. "This was not a threat," they said. "Nothing will happen." News of Van der Stap's arrest, first reported by independent journalist Brian Krebs, caused a stir in the cybersecurity community. Van der Stap's 2023 convictions of data theft and extortion had already received widespread publicity, as did his subsequent public disavowal of cybercrime. On his personal website, Van der Stap acknowledged that his journey "hasn't been a straight line" but said his experience had taught him that "knowledge is for building and protecting, not breaking." Korper said he had carefully vetted Van der Stap before hiring him, monitored him during his employment, and was shocked by the arrest. "I truly believe that people deserve a second chance, but in this case I was not thanked for it," Korper said. "Absolutely everybody I talked to is flabbergasted." The executive said he had hired an outside firm to investigate whether Van der Stap had hacked Neo Security or its customers, but so far investigators have found no evidence that he acted against his employer or its clients. Korper and Van der Stap have not been in touch since the arrest, Korper said. Attempts by Reuters to reach Van der Stap or identify a lawyer or representative were not successful.

item.title: Russia raises 2027 military spending by 27%, budget documents show
item.description: Russia plans to spend 17.1 trillion roubles ($202.58 billion) on defence in 2027, around 27% more than the 13.5 trillion roubles originally budgeted and the highest figure since the start of the war in Ukraine in 2022, government documents seen by Reuters showed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Darya Korsunskaya
item.content:encoded: Russia plans to spend 17.1 trillion roubles ($202.58 billion) on defence in 2027, around 27% more than the 13.5 trillion roubles originally budgeted and the highest figure since the start of the war in Ukraine in 2022, government documents seen by Reuters showed on Monday. Total defence spending will amount to 50 trillion roubles in the next three years, according to the documents. In 2026 the government planned to spend 12.1 trillion roubles on defence but the actual amount is classified and will not be disclosed. Some military spending can also be accounted for in other parts of the budget. The documents also showed the government raised its estimate for its 2026 budget deficit to 3.2% of gross domestic product, from 1.6% of GDP previously. Budget spending in 2026 will increase by 13.2% to 48.6 trillion roubles or 20.9% of GDP. The government is expected to submit the draft budget to parliament by October 1. Last week, it announced plans for new tax hikes in 2027 to finance the growing deficit. The documents showed that a new windfall tax on metals and mining companies was expected to raise about 200 billion roubles annually. The documents showed that in 2026 the government will increase its net borrowing plan by 26% to 5 trillion roubles and spend 459 billion roubles - about 11% of the liquid part of its National Wealth Fund - to reduce the deficit. It also cut the oil and gas revenue estimate for 2026 to 7.6 trillion roubles from 8.9 trillion roubles previously. The documents showed that state debt is set to rise to 21.7% of GDP in 2027 from 19.9% of GDP in 2026, above the 20% level seen by the authorities as safe. Total borrowing in 2027 will increase by 43% to 7.7 trillion roubles. ($1 = 84.4113 roubles)

item.title: Mallorca keeper Cuellar in hospital after canteen structure collapses
item.description: Real Mallorca goalkeeper Ivan "Pichu" Cuellar had a frightening start to the week when part of the decor in the club's training ground dining room collapsed on him on Monday, leaving the 42-year-old with a serious head injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Real Mallorca goalkeeper Ivan "Pichu" Cuellar had a frightening start to the week when part of the decor in the club's training ground dining room collapsed on him on Monday, leaving the 42-year-old with a serious head injury. The club said Cuellar was taken to hospital after the incident at the Ciutat Esportiva Antonio Asensio, also known as Son Bibiloni, before the squad's scheduled training session under manager Luis Garcia ahead of Sunday's Spanish second division match against Girona. Despite the alarm caused by the accident, Mallorca said the keeper was recovering well, as doctors monitored his condition and ruled out further complications. "This morning, Ivan 'Pichu' Cuellar suffered a serious head injury after a large structure, which formed part of the decor in the dining room at the Ciutat Esportiva collapsed," the club said in a statement. "The player has been taken to hospital for treatment and will remain under observation for the next 24 hours." Cuellar's injury leaves Garcia short of options in goal, with Lucas Bergstrom on international duty with Finland, leaving Arnau Tenas as the only one first-team keeper available.

item.title: 米ジャンク債に需給悪化の兆し、投資家消化しきれず－ゴールドマン
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ゴールドマン・サックス・グループのチーフ・クレジット・ストラテジスト、アマンダ・ライナム氏は28日、米国のハイイールド債市場で、急増した社債の発行を投資家が吸収しきれなくなり始め、リスクプレミアムが5カ月ぶりの高水準に上昇していると指摘した。

ライナム氏は、ブルームバーグテレビジョンで「市場は、夏の初めに投資適格債市場で見られたのと同じような、一時的な需給悪化に備えている。ハイイールド債でもそれが起きている」と語った。

ソフトバンクグループによる100億ドル（約1兆5700億円）の起債など、大型のジャンク債発行が相次いだことで、9月の社債発行額は385億1000万ドルに達し、ハイイールド債市場では今年最も発行が活発な月となった。一方、パラマウント・スカイダンスは今週、投資適格債とハイイールド債で444億ドルを調達する計画だ。

ライナム氏によると、相次ぐ起債に加え、今年後半も多くの案件が予定されていることや債券利回りの上昇が、社債スプレッドへの上昇圧力となっている。ブルームバーグの指数データによると、ジャンク債と米国債の利回り差（スプレッド）は、25日終値時点で12ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）拡大して294bpと、4月以来の高水準に達した。

信用力が最も低い層であるCCC格社債の平均スプレッドは968bpで、2023年11月以来の高水準となった。

債券利回りの上昇により、社債は利回りを重視する投資家にとって、魅力的な投資先となっているが、ゴールドマンは、金利上昇でクレジットスプレッドが拡大するリスクを警戒している。

ライナム氏によると、ゴールドマンの集計では、今年これまでに債券市場でAI関連の取り組みに伴う発行額が約6000億ドルという「極めて驚異的な数字」に達している。このうちハイパースケーラー関連は約40%にとどまり、AI関連の資金調達がいかに幅広く広がっているかが示された。

item.title: US to grant sanctions waiver for flights between Iran and Iraq's Najaf, source says
item.description: The US Treasury Department waiver would allow Iraqi Airways to fly back and forth between Iran and the Shi'ite holy city of Najaf in Iraq for one month.
item.dc:creator: Timour Azhari, Ahmed Rasheed
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump's administration was set to grant a limited waiver to its Iran sanctions program on Monday to allow for flights carrying Shi'ite Muslim religious pilgrims between Iran and Iraq, a person with direct knowledge of the matter said. The source, who is involved in the deliberations, said the US Treasury Department waiver would allow Iraqi Airways to fly back and forth between Iran and the Shi'ite holy city of Najaf in Iraq for one month, with a more permanent waiver potentially following. Iraq halted flights to and from Iran on Friday, in line with US sanctions. The source said the move aimed to ease pressure on the Iraqi government of Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi, who has sought to deepen ties with Washington while also balancing a strong relationship with Iraq's influential neighbour, Iran. Trump's effort to impose a crippling economic blockade on Iran is forcing regional governments to scale back ties with Iran, creating potential backlash against those states, particularly those that balance their ties with both Washington and Tehran. Zaidi's office over the weekend said that Iraq was seeking an exemption for travel between Iran and Iraq for medical treatment, education and pilgrimage. An Iraqi official said the Iraqi government was in talks with the US about the Najaf exemption and expected flights between Iran and Najaf to resume within 48 hours. The US State Department referred questions to the Treasury Department, which did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In recent days, countries including Turkey, the UAE and Iraq have cancelled direct flights with Iran as a result of US pressure. In response, Iranian officials have threatened to halt regional air travel if Iran's air links continued to be cut. With Shi'ite religious pilgrims travelling between Iran and Iraq each year to visit key shrine cities, Iraq is perhaps in the most sensitive position. Najaf, a center for religious study, draws millions of pilgrims a year to the shrine of Imam Ali, the first Shi'ite leader, and the world’s largest and oldest active Islamic cemetery. The source said that barring flights between the two countries could cause severe backlash against Iraq's government by uniting Shi'ites who follow Iran's supreme leader and those who follow Iraq's Grand Ayatollah Ali al-Sistani, undermining US efforts to reduce Iranian influence in Iraq. Zaidi has offered to provide safeguards for the flights, including rigorous screening and information sharing as well as ensuring the flights are not used for transfer of weapons, sanctioned individuals or illicit money, the source said.

item.title: 【欧州市況】債券下落、原油と天然ガス価格上昇受け－株は横ばい
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 28日の欧州債券市場は、原油と天然ガス価格の上昇によりインフレ懸念が増したことで、下落した。

ドイツ30年債利回りは一時6ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）近く上昇して3.97%と、9日以来の大幅上昇となった。

ラガルド欧州中央銀行（ECB）総裁が、前回の政策委員会会合以降の債券利回り上昇は成長とインフレを鈍化させると述べたことを受け、短期金融市場では、今後5カ月間の利上げ観測が後退した。

英国債も売られ、2年債利回りは一時10bp上昇して4.94%となった。ヒーリー英財務相が、労働党大会での演説で財政規律を堅持する考えを表明したものの、市場の反応は限定的だった。

欧州株はほぼ横ばいだった。米10年債利回りが5.25%を上回ったことを受け、それまでの上げを失った。

ストックス欧州600指数は、ほぼ変わらずで取引を終えた。英住宅建設会社のテイラー・ウィンピー、ベルウェイ、パーシモン、バラット・レッドロウがいずれも10%超上昇した。英政府が初めて住宅を購入する人を対象とする新たな融資制度を発表し、JPモルガン・チェースのアナリストが「状況を一変させる」可能性があると評したことが材料となった。

世界的に債券利回りが上昇する中、欧州株は今月、5カ月続いた上昇に終止符を打つ可能性がある。

原題：30Y Bunds Suffer Worst Day Since Sept. 9: End-of-Day Curves、European Stocks Steady as Bond Rout Offsets UK Homebuilder Gains（抜粋）

COPENHAGEN, Sept 28 : Manchester City chief executive Ferran Soriano said that the club would do everything to clear their name when addressing the European Football Clubs board on Monday, adding the procedure would take years before reaching an end, a source familiar with the discussions told Reuters. Soriano, who sits on EFC's board, also declined to comment to reporters on City being found guilty of 114 of 115 alleged breaches of the Premier League's financial rules, according to media reports confirmed to Reuters by a source familiar with the situation. City are expected to appeal and have consistently denied wrongdoing. The case will provide one backdrop to the General Assembly, which brings together some 500 of the 850 members of the EFC in Copenhagen for Tuesday's meeting and comes at a time when governance questions are also dominating debate at the top of the world game.

EFC chairman Nasser Al-Khelaifi is due to address delegates, with UEFA President Aleksander Ceferin also attending. FIFA President Gianni Infantino was invited but is very unlikely to be present with the FIFA delegation expected to be represented by Secretary General Mattias Grafstrom. At global level, Infantino has proposed an independent external review of FIFA's governance and decision-making after the collapse of a plan to bring private investment into its commercial rights business, a proposal that triggered resistance from several confederations and national associations. The debate has raised broader questions about how major decisions are taken, how much power rests with FIFA's leadership and what role clubs, leagues, confederations and national associations should have in shaping the game. The City case adds a domestic dimension to the same debate, focusing attention on financial regulation, enforcement and the relationship between powerful clubs and governing bodies. No sanction has yet been announced and the process is not complete. Ceferin's presence will add further weight to the general assembly, with UEFA itself central to the wider debate over governance, regulation and the balance of power across European and world football.

Sept 28 : Formula One champion Lando Norris has apologised to Alpine's Franco Colapinto for saying the Argentine driver deserved a race ban for causing a crash that took him out of last Sunday's Azerbaijan Grand Prix. Colapinto ploughed into French teammate Pierre Gasly after a safety car restart in Baku with the collision also collecting McLaren's Norris.   "After the race, I sent Franco a message apologising for the comments I made that I simply should not have said," Norris posted on Instagram.  "I know better and emotions were running high but that is not an excuse, it was wrong of me. I've made mistakes of my own over the years and I know this is very much a part of racing and fighting on the limit.

Norris, who has received abuse from some of the Argentine's supporters, had said Colapinto deserved at least a one race ban for causing Sunday's crash. "It is not driving that deserves to be in Formula One," he added. Colapinto has received online abuse in the past while his fans have also been blamed for death threats directed at other drivers.    Alpine issued a statement on Sunday addressing online abuse after the race in Baku "not only aimed at one of our own drivers, but also members of the Formula One community, including media, and to our racing counterparts who we respect, admire and revel competing against in the pinnacle of motosport". "Mistakes happen when racing at the limit and no matter the result or outcome, nobody should be subject to hateful or abusive comments," the team added. item.title: Robert Hunter to be new UnitedHealthcare president
item.description: UnitedHealth executive Robert Hunter said in a LinkedIn post on Monday he would take on the role of president of UnitedHealthcare, the company's insurance division.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: UnitedHealth (UNH.N) executive Robert Hunter said in a LinkedIn post on Monday he would take on the role of president of UnitedHealthcare, the company's insurance division. Here are some details: A UnitedHealth veteran, Hunter has held several roles at the company over the past 15 years. He was previously the CEO of government programs at the company, as well as held the top role at UnitedHealthcare's medicare and retirement segment. "In this new role, my focus will be on helping to accelerate our modernization agenda to achieve a future where healthcare is more connected, easier to navigate and simpler to understand," Hunter said. Tim Noel will continue as the chief executive of UnitedHealthcare, the company confirmed to Reuters.

item.title: Miners bound to megadeal playbook in pursuit of global scale
item.description: Mining companies are set on building scale through M&A and partnerships to tackle financial and geopolitical hurdles, despite several thwarted megadeals over the past year.
item.dc:creator: Clara Denina
item.content:encoded: Mining companies are set on building scale through M&A and partnerships to tackle financial and geopolitical hurdles, despite several thwarted megadeals over the past year. Gold Fields (GFIJ.J) , whose $27.1 billion [USN:L1N45K003 TEXT:"offer"] to forge the world's second-largest gold producer was rejected by Northern Star (NST.AX) on Monday, is the latest to go into battle. Gold Fields is employing the same reasoning as copper miners: diversification, synergies and financial strength. "These big miners tend to fund project development through their balance sheet using debt rather than capital raising, so they need to be bigger to have more cashflow to manage that debt," said analyst Glyn Lawcock at Barrenjoey. Although BHP (BHP.AX) failed in its bids for Anglo American (AAL.L) , and Rio Tinto (RIO.L) , (RIO.AX) abandoned its Glencore (GLEN.L) approach, investors and people familiar with boardroom discussions say boards remain convinced that bigger is better to obtain financing for multi-billion-dollar mines. Mining companies also face huge political pressure to secure copper and other critical minerals that are at the forefront of energy, economic and national security agendas. New copper mines can cost $10 billion to $20 billion to develop and take a decade or more to build, raising questions about whether companies have the financial heft to compete in a market where quality deposits are increasingly scarce. "Increasingly, this isn't simply about the size of the orebody. It's about who has the balance sheet and capabilities to fund, permit, build and staff a long-duration project," said Richard Sellschop, McKinsey senior partner. GROWTH AND DISCIPLINE Shareholders who endured writedowns from the industry's last M&A spree are demanding that any growth come with strict capital discipline, creating a fundamental challenge for boards. "The scale argument is a very valid one," said George Cheveley, portfolio manager at NinetyOne, adding that as mining becomes increasingly political over critical minerals, mid-sized miners lack the scale to navigate government intervention. But scale is not universally beneficial, Sellschop said. It creates advantages in capital-intensive assets such as smelting and refining, but can become a disadvantage in niche markets. Unlike the dealmaking binge of the 2000s, boards now insist growth must coexist with, not replace, shareholder returns. METAL POLITICS Mining has become more risky as governments seek control over critical minerals, making size more valuable as protection against resource nationalism, investors and analysts say. Countries from Indonesia to Chile have moved to increase state control over mining assets, while the US and EU have introduced trade restrictions aimed at reshoring supply chains. BHP's failed $49 billion approach for Anglo American has reinforced a preference for internal growth and joint ventures over transformational M&A. At least for now. The company's partnership with Lundin Mining represents a strategy of spreading risk across multiple developments rather than betting on a single large acquisition. Investors say they are willing to back growth, but only if it meets higher hurdles than in the past. Some distinguish between organic growth and joint ventures versus large acquisitions that can destroy value if integration fails. The mining industry's last growth phase ended badly. Companies including BHP, Rio Tinto and Anglo American spent heavily on acquisitions between 2005 and 2012, only to write down billions when commodity prices collapsed. That led to a decade focused on cost-cutting, asset sales and returning cash. But capital required to develop new deposits has soared while supplies have dwindled, forcing boards to confront whether their companies are large enough to compete. Rio Tinto's tie-up with Glencore remains a possibility, investors say, even though CEO Simon Trott has pointed away from such M&A, saying it "should be looking to partner and bolt-on". Glencore, meanwhile, remains committed to building scale. MKI Global Partners said in a note that the copper rationale remains and Glencore's recent moves could ease structural issues relating to dealmaking, with the Swiss-based miner pursuing an Australian listing to broaden its shareholder base there. "While none of this is explicitly linked to Rio, the combination of a stronger standalone business, greater Australian relevance ... means the backdrop to any renewed discussions may look somewhat different today," MKI said.

item.title: 英中銀ラムズデン副総裁、インフレ上振れ圧力強まれば利上げも
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のラムズデン副総裁は、インフレの「上振れ圧力」が引き続き強まれば、利上げに踏み切る用意があると述べた。

ラムズデン氏は28日にロンドンで行った講演で、エネルギー価格の上昇が賃金と物価の上昇の連鎖を引き起こす恐れがあるとの見方を示した。ブリーデン、ロンバルデリ両副総裁も先週、同様の懸念を示していた。

金融政策委員会（MPC）は今月、6対3で政策金利を3.75%に据え置くことを決めたが、インフレ率は4%前後でピークに達するとの見通しを示した。これは英中銀の従来予想を大幅に上回り、同行が対応を迫られる水準となる。投資家らは11月の英中銀会合で0.25ポイントの利上げを見込んでいる。

ラムズデン氏は、イラン戦争に伴うエネルギーコストの上昇が物価に及ぼすリスクを引き続き注視していると説明。国内の食品価格への二次的な影響を示す兆候や、近く公表される企業の賃上げ計画に関する調査を見極める考えを示した。

同氏は「インフレ見通しへの上振れ圧力がさらに強まるようであれば、政策金利を引き上げる根拠となり得る」と発言。「インフレ見通しを巡るリスクは、外部・国内の要因ともに、上振れ方向に一段と傾いている」と述べた。

その一方で、英中銀の現在の政策スタンスはすでに引き締め的だとも強調。イラン戦争がなければ、「今ごろまでに少なくとも2回の利下げが行われ、政策金利は現在より少なくとも0.5%低い水準になっていたはずだ」と語った。

原題：BOE’s Ramsden Joins Warnings That Rates May Have to Rise

item.title: 再送-キーウ中心部にロシア攻撃、科学研究機関ドローン直撃 1人死亡
item.description:
(見出しを手直しして再送しました)
[キーウ／モスクワ ２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
(見出しを手直しして再送しました)

[キーウ／モスクワ　２８日　ロイター] - ロシアがウクライナの首都キーウに対する攻撃を強める中、２８日は中心部にある国立科学アカデミーに無人機（ドローン）が突っ込み、クリチコ市長によると少なくとも１人が死亡し、１９人が負傷した。

攻撃を受けた国立科学アカデミーの建物は歴史的建造物。火災が発生し、消防隊員による消火活動が続けられる中、倒壊した建物の中で行方不明者の捜索が行われている。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領によると、首都キーウでは医療施設や製薬会社の建物のほか、ガソリンスタンドなども攻撃を受けた。ウクライナの他の都市や地域でも民間施設や企業、通信インフラが標的になったとしており、「ウクライナの全てのパートナー国に、ウクライナを支援することが人々の命を守ることにほかならないと理解してもらいたい」と通信アプリ「テレグラム」に投稿した。

ウクライナのシビハ外相は、ロシアが平日の日中に科学研究機関を攻撃したことを非難。「ロシアは国際社会が容認すると考える行動の限界を意図的に広げている。こうした攻撃に強く対応しなければ、次の攻撃が助長される」と述べた。

この日はウクライナの他の都市も攻撃を受け、東部ドニプロペトロウスク州のドニプロではビジネスセンターへのドローン攻撃で少なくとも３人が死亡した。

ロシアはここ数週間、キーウを含むウクライナ各地の都市に対し、高い高度を高速で飛行するジェット推進型ドローンによる攻撃を実施。ゼレンスキー大統領は２６日、ウクライナ軍が迎撃できているのは発射されたドローンの半数強にとどまると述べ、従来のプロペラ式ドローンと比べて迎撃率が大幅に低下しているとの認識を示している。

ロシア国防省は２８日、夜間から日中にかけてキーウにある複数のデータセンターを攻撃したと表明。このほか、ウクライナ軍への補給に関与していたとロシアが主張する複数の貨物船を攻撃したとし、南部オデーサに向かっていた貨物船３隻のほか、チョルノモルスク港に停泊していた貨物船１隻などを標的にしたと明らかにした。

ロイターはロシア国防省の発表内容を独自に確認できていない。

item.title: Fourteen killed in fire at pyrotechnics factory in Russia's Yaroslavl region, TASS reports
item.description: Fourteen people were killed in a fire at a pyrotechnics factory in Russia's Yaroslavl region on Monday, state-run news agency TASS reported, citing emergency services.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Fourteen people were killed in a fire at a pyrotechnics factory in Russia's Yaroslavl region on Monday, state-run news agency TASS reported, citing emergency services. One person was being treated in hospital and TASS said the fire had been extinguished. Regional Governor Mikhail Evrayev, posting on Telegram, said 10 deaths had been confirmed and search and rescue operations would proceed round the clock. The blaze engulfed two buildings in the village of Kubrinsk near the town of Pereslavl-Zalessky. Around 200 emergency personnel were deployed to the scene, Evrayev said. Russian authorities have opened a criminal case over alleged violations of industrial safety regulations, the agency said.

item.title: White House weighs red-dyed diesel tax relief to lower fuel prices
item.description: The White House is considering regulatory relief that would allow broader sales of red-dyed diesel as part of an effort to bring down soaring prices, a move that could allow some buyers to avoid the federal fuel tax, according to two people familiar with the discussions.
item.dc:creator: Jarrett Renshaw, Nicole Jao
item.content:encoded: The White House is considering regulatory relief that would allow broader sales of red-dyed diesel as part of an effort to bring down soaring prices, a move that could allow some buyers to avoid the federal fuel tax, according to two people familiar with the discussions. The red-dye proposal has emerged from days of administration deliberations as one of the leading alternatives to a diesel export ban, which has been discussed as global supply disruptions drive prices to record levels. [USN:SPN45A01C TEXT:"President Donald Trump has backed"] a ban, but that has faced widespread opposition from the oil industry and other parts of the business community. The Trump administration is looking for ways to bring down diesel prices without disrupting fuel supplies or creating additional costs elsewhere in the economy, under growing pressure to ease fuel costs as November's midterm elections approach and Trump's economic approval ratings remain under strain. The administration has also been seeking voluntary commitments from major refiners to limit diesel exports, Reuters reported last week, as officials weigh alternatives to a government-imposed export ban. Energy Secretary Chris Wright has contacted executives at several major refiners to gauge their willingness to engage in such an action. A White House official said no final decisions have been made, but the president is weighing all options to lower prices. Trump told a Fox News reporter on Sunday while attending the Presidents Cup golf tournament in Illinois that he is "very seriously" weighing a ban on diesel exports. “That can oftentimes lead to a little bit of an increase in gasoline for cars, so we’re looking at it very seriously. We may do it,” he added. RED DYE PLAN The tax proposal would expand the circumstances under which red-dyed diesel, which is generally reserved for off-road uses such as farming and is exempt from most federal fuel taxes, could be sold for broader use, the people said. The administration is weighing the proposal as Trump seeks to ease fuel costs that have climbed sharply in recent weeks. Under current federal rules, the tax on highway diesel is 24.4 cents per gallon, while dyed diesel is exempt from that tax but remains subject to a 0.1-cent-per-gallon charge that funds the federal Leaking Underground Storage Tank Trust Fund. Allowing wider sales of dyed diesel could reduce the federal tax burden on eligible purchases, although the impact on the price paid by consumers would depend on how the relief is structured and how much of the savings is passed through by fuel sellers. Farm Belt lawmakers are also pressing the administration and Congress to act as high diesel prices squeeze farmers heading into harvest, when fuel is a major operating cost. US Representative Ashley Hinson, a Republican running for the Senate in Iowa, has called for the House to return to Washington before the midterm elections and pause diesel exports and suspend the federal gas tax, while also proposing a diesel relief program for farmers and truckers. Patrick De Haan, head of petroleum analysis at GasBuddy, said the proposal would not address the supply imbalances that have driven up on-road diesel prices. Farmers already use untaxed dyed diesel, he noted, while allowing truckers to use the fuel could save them the federal tax without increasing diesel supplies. "I can't think that this would have any impact at all," De Haan said. "It's simply diesel with red dye added that's not taxed. It does nothing to improve supply or impact price." The idea comes as several states have moved to relax restrictions on dyed diesel amid surging fuel costs. Texas, the largest energy consuming state, on Monday issued a statewide disaster declaration to allow expanded use of dyed diesel and lift restrictions on allowable weight for fuel, agricultural, and timber loads. Alabama, Louisiana and Nebraska also have each taken temporary steps in recent days to allow broader use of the tax-exempt fuel or suspend state penalties, while Alabama and Louisiana have sought additional relief from the federal government. The potential move comes as the national average price of diesel has climbed above $6 a gallon, putting more pressure on farmers, truckers and other businesses that rely on the fuel. The American Petroleum Institute, the nation's largest oil trade group, said it shares the administration’s focus on lowering diesel costs and welcomes consideration of a range of options, including red-dyed diesel waivers.

item.title: LeBron soaks in brotherly love in Philly media debut
item.description: "You guys know who I am, right?"
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: "You guys know who I am, right?" The name is familiar but the 76ers red, white and blue jersey was new for LeBron James, who opened his introductory press conference on Monday with a quick quip amid the extraordinary buzz that surrounds his arrival in Philadelphia. Wearing the Sixers jersey in public for the first time, he quickly removed his name tag from the table as he met an overflowing crowd of reporters at the Sixers training complex, where his arrival has been regarded as nothing short of a coronation. "I'm super excited to get in front of these fans, they know sports," said James, with a shaven head to match his clean start at his fourth franchise following a successful tenure with the Los Angeles Lakers. "They know ball." The 41-year-old four-times MVP took a [USN:L6N43219Q TEXT:"historic pay cut"] - and left behind his own [USN:L1N3LZ005 TEXT:"son-turned-teammate Bronny"] - to begin a record-extending 24th season with a team he is convinced can lift the NBA trophy. Fans hope he is right, with the glory days of Julius "Dr J" Erving, who brought home their last title in 1983, an ever-distant memory. "I didn't leave my family to lose in the second round," said James. "I know that for sure." JAMES NARROWED LIST TO FIVE TEAMS His reported $8 million two-year contract in Philadelphia pales in comparison to the roughly $52 million he made in his final season in Los Angeles. But James is chasing the kind of glory money cannot buy with a cast of elite talent beside him. The Sixers acquired 2024 Finals MVP Jaylen Brown days before James made his announcement, bringing together the Celtics veteran with All-Star Tyrese Maxey, who averaged 28.3 points per game last season, and big man Joel Embiid. The 2023 MVP Embiid debuted a noticeably slimmer physique on Monday, after years of injury issues. "Joel is one of the most talented guys that we have in the world and, and obviously we all know that, you know, for him it's been about help. You know, how can he stay healthy to be the best version of himself," said James. James told reporters he had a list of five teams that he was considering before landing on Philadelphia, and fans might have Maxey to thank for making the difference, with James citing their close friendship. "I kind of picked his brain a lot on not only where his career is going, you know, how he sees the franchise here, how much he believes in the franchise, and if I was to come here, how does he see me fitting in," said James. "I understand my personality and what comes with me, sometimes it could be a negative. You know, I understand some people maybe can't handle what I may bring to the table and I was just giving, asking all the questions that I could ask to him and it wasn't just one conversation." 'BEST VERSION OF MYSELF' James' arrival has sent a jolt through Philadelphia, where murals of the four-times champion went up on buildings before he arrived as they hope to build a deeper run in the post-season after reaching the conference semi-finals last year. James said he had not decided whether his contract with the Sixers would be the last of his career. "I'm just looking at it every single day on how I can be the best version of myself for this franchise while I'm here," he added. James and Philadelphia will start on the road on October 20 against the [USN:L6N42J14M TEXT:"reigning champion"] New York Knicks, who ended 53 years of heartbreak for the five boroughs [USN:L6N42J1EI TEXT:"in June"].

item.title: French far-right leader Bardella says he has filed lawsuit over antisemitic remarks claim
item.description: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella said on Monday he had filed a defamation lawsuit against investigative website Mediapart over a report alleging he made antisemitic remarks in private messages over a decade ago, saying the story was an effort to "destabilise" campaigning ahead of next year's election.
item.dc:creator: Michel Rose
item.content:encoded: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella said on Monday he had filed a defamation lawsuit against investigative website Mediapart over a report alleging he made antisemitic remarks in private messages over a decade ago, saying the story was an effort to "destabilise" campaigning ahead of next year's election. The 31-year-old leads the far-right National Rally (RN) party which is seeking to clear its racist image and build close ties with Israel. The party's candidate, Marine Le Pen, is leading polls for the April presidential election. Mediapart, in a report published on Monday, said it had reviewed dozens of private messages from 2013 to 2015 — the early years of Bardella's career in the National Front, the forerunner of the RN — that it said showed a pattern of antisemitic and conspiratorial rhetoric. Mediapart cited one message in which it said Bardella claimed "all the banks are owned by Jews". The left-leaning outlet, which has a long history of unearthing political scandals in France, said it had independently authenticated the private messages. Reuters did not independently authenticate them. Mediapart said it also drew on first-hand accounts of former party colleagues, whom it identified by first name and last initial. Speaking on broadcaster CNews, Bardella said: "These statements are completely delusional. They are not mine." He added, "There is clearly an attempt to destabilise the campaign, coincidentally, just months before an election where we are leading in the polls. Again, I believe the French people are not fooled. They see that everything is being done to undermine us." Bardella has become the face of the RN's decade-long effort to "de-demonise", or normalise, its image. He was the party's de facto presidential candidate until July, when an appeals court cleared Le Pen to hold elected office after a conviction over misuse of funds. Bardella will be France's prime minister if she wins next year's vote. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot wrote in a post on social media platform X: "To all those with short memories: antisemitism is not a mere blip for the RN; it is the very history of this party. This is the true face of the far right." Le Pen, speaking with reporters on Monday, said she believed the report could "only be a fake, a manipulation, a dirty trick". A [USN:L6N45K0G1 TEXT:"Monday poll"] showed her coming first in next April's first-round vote and beating both leftist and centrist candidates in a May runoff. A slew of antisemitic, Islamophobic and racist comments by some RN candidates derailed the party's hopes of winning a parliamentary majority in France's legislative vote in 2024. Bardella at the time pledged to avoid such "casting errors" in the future by systematically kicking out any candidates with a history of toxic statements.

item.title: 韓国、ウクライナ代理大使に抗議 北朝鮮の捕虜移送公表に
item.description:
Heekyong Yang Jack Kim
[ソウル ２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Heekyong Yang　Jack Kim

[ソウル ２８日 ロイター] - 韓国外務省は２８日、北朝鮮兵捕虜の韓国への移送をウクライナ側が公表したことを受け、在韓国ウクライナ大使館のアンドリー・ベシキン代理大使を呼び出して抗議した。公式な説明と謝罪も求めた。両国間で非公表とするとの明確な合意があったと主張。ウクライナに対し、強い遺憾の意を表明したと述べた。

ゼレンスキー大統領は先週の国連総会の演説で、ロシア側として戦って捕虜となった北朝鮮兵２人を韓国に引き渡したと述べていた。韓国大統領府も２７日、ウクライナに対して公式な説明と謝罪を要求していた。

韓国外務省は、非公表とする合意はなかったとするウクライナ大統領府の説明についても「虚偽の声明」だとして抗議し、再発防止のための措置を講じるよう求めたと表明。

韓国メディアの報道によると、ベシキン氏は韓国の立場を正確に伝えると述べたという。

トランプ米大統領はこのところ、北朝鮮との対話への意欲を見せ、韓国も支持する考えを示している。

item.title: カタール仲介団、米・イランと個別協議へ 戦争終結目指す
item.description: [２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２８日 ロイター] - カタールの仲介団が２８日か２９日に、ニューヨークでイランのアラグチ外相と、また別途米国側と協議する見通しだと、交渉について説明を受けた当局者がロイターに明らかにした。戦争終結に向けた新たな取り組みとなる。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた同当局者によると、協議では、イランが先週、国連総会に合わせて提示した７日間の計画の修正案が焦点となる見通し。

アラグチ氏は国連総会への出席後もニューヨークに滞在している。仲介団との協議に米国側から誰が出席するかは、現時点では不明。

イランの準国営ＩＳＮＡ通信はその後、アラグチ氏がニューヨーク時間２８日午前に米国で仲介団と会談すると確認した。双方は「現状に関する最新の提案や見解を検討する」という。

一方、イラン外務省のバガイ報道官は２８日、その後国営メディアに対し、アラグチ氏のニューヨーク滞在は延長されておらず、当初の予定通りテヘランに戻ると述べた。仲介団との協議についてはコメントしなかった。

＜トランプ氏、今週の追加協議を示唆＞

イランの７日間の計画は、イランとレバノンでの全ての敵対行為の停止、数十億ドル相当のイラン資産の凍結解除、イラン産原油に対する制裁の解除、米国によるイランの港湾封鎖の解除を想定している。

その上でイランはホルムズ海峡の再開を認め、米国とイランはイランの核開発計画を巡る協議も再開する。

トランプ米大統領は２６日、イランの提案を拒否したと表明。イランは深刻な経済的圧力にさらされているため、早期の合意を望んでいると述べた。

ただ、２７日には米ニュースサイトのアクシオスに対し、米交渉団が今週、さらなる協議に臨むとの見通しも示した。

item.title: Trump's AI meeting with tech CEOs to focus on finding balance, US House speaker says
item.description: President Donald Trump's meeting with tech CEOs on artificial intelligence on Tuesday will focus on finding a balance between innovation and oversight, House Speaker Mike Johnson said, as the federal government seeks to define its role in the burgeoning technology.
item.dc:creator: Katharine Jackson, Karen Freifeld
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump's meeting with tech CEOs on artificial intelligence on Tuesday will focus on finding a balance between innovation and oversight, House Speaker Mike Johnson said, as the federal government seeks to define its role in the burgeoning technology. "We do not need a moratorium. We do not need to jump in and hyper-regulate this, because we'll lose the race to China," Johnson said in an interview on Monday with Fox Business Network. "The innovation is important to continue, but we have to strike the right balance. That's what the conversation is going to be about." Meta's Mark Zuckerberg, Anthropic's Dario Amodei, OpenAI's Greg Brockman and Nvidia's Jensen Huang are among those who will attend Tuesday's meeting with Trump and Johnson, according to sources familiar with the matter. Other possible attendees include Google CEO Sundar Pichai and SpacexAI executive Elon Musk. The White House meeting comes as leading AI companies are calling for slowing development of increasingly capable AI systems, warning of the risks to humanity and appealing for governments to work together to manage the increasingly powerful technology. Trump has downplayed concerns over the misuse of artificial intelligence harming people as he stressed the importance of maintaining America's competitive edge over China. He says the US already has [USN:L6N45E0R5 TEXT:"guardrails in place"] for the powerful technology, including at the Department of Justice. Johnson said the US should be mindful of safety but not stymie the technology's development. "I think there may be a role for the DOJ if things go awry. But what we need before we get to that stage is transparency, and we need some oversight," he said on "Mornings with Fox Business." [USN:L6N4520JA TEXT:"Lawmakers"] in both parties have questioned Trump's hands-off approach even as the technology raises fears about safety, job losses and the concentration of power among a handful of tech companies. House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries said AI industry leaders were pleading for some government action and Congress has a responsibility to protect the American people. "So, when it comes to AI safety, it certainly seems to me that we need to actually lean in boldly and responsibly — now," Jeffries told CNBC on Monday. The president had dinner with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on Sunday. Anthropic and its rivals have called for slowing AI development. These include OpenAI, Google’s (GOOGL.O) DeepMind, Microsoft (MSFT.O) and xAI.

item.title: ECBラガルド総裁、利回り上昇で成長鈍化・インフレ波及を抑制
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 欧州中央銀行（ECB）のラガルド総裁は、債券利回りの上昇が景気拡大を抑えるとともに、エネルギーコスト上昇がインフレに波及するのを限定するとの見方を示した。

ラガルド氏は28日、欧州議会の公聴会で「成長は底堅さを維持しているものの、前回会合以降、長期金利は大幅に上昇した。これにより成長は鈍化し、インフレへの波及も9月の見通しで予想した以上に抑えられるだろう」と述べた。

これまでのところ二次的な影響は見られておらず、ECBは「インフレを抑制するため、必要に応じて慎重に対応すべきだ」と、同氏は語った。

ECB当局者は、インフレを抑制し、エネルギー価格の上昇が幅広い物価や賃上げ要求に波及するのを防ぐため、追加利上げの必要性を検討している。

中東での紛争に加え、ECB当局者は世界的な債券売りにも対応を迫られている。これは、財政が逼迫（ひっぱく）している一部のユーロ圏加盟国にとって特に懸念材料となっている。

原題：ECB’s Lagarde Says Higher Yields to Slow Growth and Inflation

item.title: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane (ACL) out for season
item.description: The Miami Dolphins placed running back De'Von Achane on season-ending injured reserve Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Miami Dolphins placed running back De'Von Achane on season-ending injured reserve Monday. Achane tore the ACL in his left knee, ESPN reported, on his third rushing attempt in the Dolphins' 24-10 setback against the Kansas City Chiefs in Miami Gardens, Fla. He hobbled off the field after being tackled awkwardly by safety Alohi Gilman. "My heart breaks for the guy," Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Monday. "You talk about him as a great player but since I've gotten to know him, watching him grow and develop and earning the captain role, becoming the leader of a team, becoming such great energy, such a great teammate, I mean, I just love his energy. I love his enthusiasm. I love his positivity." Achane finished with 17 yards rushing on three carries, and no receptions on one target. For the season, he has rushed for 127 yards on 34 attempts with no touchdowns in three games. He has seven catches for 49 yards and no scores. Second-year pro Ollie Gordon replaced Achane as the lead back for the Dolphins (0-3) and rushed for 41 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries. "Everybody has to step up. There are going to be great opportunities," Hafley said, mentioning both Gordon and receiver Malik Washington, who rushed for 110 yards and a touchdown last season. Achane posted career highs with 1,350 rushing yards and 1,838 yards from scrimmage and made his first Pro Bowl last season. A third-round pick by Miami in 2023, he has 4,510 yards from scrimmage and 35 touchdowns through 47 career games (39 starts). --Field Level Media

LONDON, Sept 28 : Bridgepoint and Astorg are considering selling Fenergo as dealmaking in the sector picks up, three people familiar with the matter said, with one saying the Irish fintech could be valued at more than £2 billion ($2.7 billion). The private equity firms have held discussions with potential buyers and are expected to appoint an investment bank later this year in a potential transaction that could attract strategic bidders, the sources told Reuters.  A sales process could be launched early in 2027, with a decision yet to be taken, said two of the sources. Bridgepoint and Astorg both declined to comment. Dublin-based Fenergo did not respond to a request for comment.

Fenergo develops software that helps more than 300 of the world's largest banks and insurers comply with regulatory requirements and manage client lifecycle processes, including onboarding, know-your-customer checks and data management. The potential deal highlights a pickup in tech dealmaking despite a selloff in software stocks earlier this year.  Thoma Bravo is exploring a sale of Foundation Software, Vista Equity Partners is considering selling banking software provider Finastra and healthcare software company Waystar is weighing its options, Reuters reported earlier this month.  Fenergo, founded and led by CEO Mark Murphy, is expected to attract interest from information services companies and exchange operators, the sources said. Astorg and Bridgepoint acquired Fenergo from Insight Partners in 2021 for an undisclosed sum. The company has also sought to capitalise on demand for AI tools, launching an agentic AI orchestration platform designed to automate workflows such as onboarding and periodic reviews. Its total revenue rose by 7.5 per cent to €149.4 million ($170 million) for the year ending in March 2025, driven by more subscription revenue and client renewals for its software products. Operating profit increased 66 per cent to €20.9 million. ($1 = 0.7539 pounds) ($1 = 0.8799 euros)

Source: Reuters

item.title: ECB eyes new currency safety nets to boost euro's global role
item.description: The European Central Bank plans to expand currency safety nets to make it easier for foreign central banks to borrow euros, ECB President Christine Lagarde said on Monday, in a bid to strengthen the single currency's global standing.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Central Bank plans to expand currency safety nets to make it easier for foreign central banks to borrow euros, ECB President Christine Lagarde said on Monday, in a bid to strengthen the single currency's global standing. The [USN:L4N3ZA02V TEXT:"push"] comes amid concerns over financial fragmentation and [USN:L4N44P02A TEXT:"growing uncertainty"] around the future of the US dollar under President Donald Trump. Lagarde said the ECB would work on swap lines, which act as a source of emergency liquidity at times of crisis by allowing foreign central banks to borrow euros in exchange for their own currency. "We will be working on swap lines that will be more responsive to the imperative of having a sovereign euro area and a strong euro," Lagarde told European lawmakers. Swap lines relieve pressure on foreign borrowers but also prevent stress abroad from spilling over into the euro area. The ECB has such arrangements with the US Federal Reserve and the central banks of Japan, Britain, Canada and Switzerland. The move is part of an ongoing ECB effort to expand the euro's international footprint. The ECB [USN:L8N41L3LR TEXT:"has received"] nearly 30 applications for a separate lending facility - known as repurchase agreements or repo - that allows foreign banks to borrow against euro collateral. Central bank officials and investors worry that the US Federal Reserve might eventually cut its own [USN:L8N41Y0WB TEXT:"swap lines"], which currently serve as the main global lifeline for trillions of dollars in foreign loans.

Sept 28 : Anthropic will not appear before an Australian senate committee hearing on AI on October 1, a source familiar with the matter said, days after a disclosure that an agent from OpenAI gained unauthorized access to the country's health system database. The Claude-parent has sought another date, the person who declined to be named, said as the invitation came late last week. OpenAI too cited the same reason and said it could not arrange for its executives to appear in the short time frame. The senate inquiry is examining the potential impacts of AI and data centers on Australian communities, industries, water and energy. It is one of several state and federal probes into AI. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei were sent written requests to appear before the senate inquiry in Canberra, after the Medicare hack.
